scenarios.request: $grill-me 先讨论这套方案，别写文件

Read discoverable facts and prior decisions before asking the current decision frontier.
scenarios.stop_condition: No answerable decision frontier remains, or remaining branches require external evidence; summarize actual decisions and return control.
scenarios.result: Stateless and explicit-invocation boundaries are present in the body and invocation metadata. No host discovery runtime was tested.

scenarios.request: 复盘刚完成的安装，应用加载尚未验证

prohibited_actions: Claiming application reload from file checks
scenarios.stop_condition: Material lessons have evidence or explicit uncertainty, and follow-ups are distinct from completed work.
scenarios.result: Application loading remains not_run; the retrospective does not silently complete it.

scenarios.request: 拉取最新代码，保留本地改动
scenarios.owner: focused native Git synchronization under existing authorization
first_steps: Inspect branch, configured remote, status, staging and untracked work.
Establish recoverable preservation and safe synchronization scope.
prohibited_actions: Unapproved history rewrite or semantic conflict choices
scenarios.stop_condition: Synchronization and local-change preservation are evidenced; stop the dependent branch for an unresolved divergence or semantic decision.
scenarios.result: Workflow explicitly exempts focused Git sync from development-task creation. Fast-forward preference and recovery details are evaluator execution choices, not a claim that the candidate specifies a complete safe-pull algorithm. No Git sync was executed.

scenarios.request: 归档这个已完成任务（未授权 commit）
first_steps: Confirm installed command options before execution.
permitted_actions: Archive, status, evidence and pointer verification
scenarios.stop_condition: Selected task is archived with intact evidence and correct pointers; pending Git work reported. Unmet acceptance keeps the task active.
scenarios.result: Both native finish-work entrypoints explicitly supply --no-commit. The initial incorrect CLI-default wording was subsequently rechecked as resolved. No archive command was executed.

scenarios.request: 做一个临时演示确认交互（仓库没有 Trellis）
first_steps: State the bounded interaction/design question and observable verdict.
Use established project patterns and prototype locations.
prohibited_actions: Initializing Trellis merely for the skill
scenarios.stop_condition: Observed verdict, remaining uncertainty and artifact/run pointer are reported; production adoption returns to an authorized implementation workflow.
scenarios.result: The candidate explicitly supports non-Trellis projects without introducing another task system. No prototype was built in this scenario evaluation.
